description: Under tests/, only the local-servers directory module (tests/helpers/local-servers/: the V5 MockAgent entry point, the transport servers, the mock LLM and the dial recorder) may import node:http, node:https, node:http2, node:net, node:tls or undici (D-17-03). Every other test reaches the network only through bin/lib/http.ts and those helpers, so the one egress gate stays in force under test.
